guidance.statement: FY27 store additions similar to FY26; target 500 beauty stores over 3-4 years, averaging 50-60 doors annually
Fashion margins to continue improving positively from Q4 baseline of +30 basis points EBITDA
guidance.quote: trajectory should be positive on margins for the fashion business

guidance.statement: Plan to significantly increase Nykaa Now marketing investment in FY27 after completing network buildout
guidance.quote: start to market Nykaa Now more actively to our consumers

guidance.quote: headroom for growth on customer acquisition for sure

delivered.statement: GMV grew 28% YoY; net revenue INR 2,648 crores, 28% YoY growth
EBITDA INR 223 crores at 8.4% margin, 67% YoY growth; PAT INR 79 crores 3% margin
Beauty GMV 27% growth, NSV 29% growth, EBITDA margin 10.3%, +70bps YoY improvement
Fashion NSV grew 42% YoY; achieved positive 30 basis points EBITDA, first profitable quarter
House of Nykaa GMV INR 3,176 crores (50% growth); Dot & Key INR 1,790 crores, 13x over 3yr
Revenue INR 10,000 crores (26% growth, $1 billion mark); EBITDA 7.5%, PAT 2%; 183% PAT growth YoY
Beauty retail 313 stores across 99 cities; Nykaa Now 75-80 rapid stores in top 7 metros

themes: Balanced diversification: Beauty 28% GMV growth, Fashion 42% Q4 NSV growth, multiple revenue streams
Margin expansion via owned brands mix (50% growth), AI-driven marketing efficiency, fulfillment optimization
Premium category momentum: K-Beauty 58% growth, dermacosmetics 40%, ultra-luxury launches (Chanel, La Prairie)
Brand ecosystem: 200+ new brands FY26; marquee partnerships H&M (#1 platform brand), Nike strategic DTC
Customer-centric growth: 45M Beauty and 11M Fashion users; strong acquisition while maintaining AOV discipline
Owned brands scaling: House of Nykaa 50% growth; Dot & Key market leader in sunscreen, moisturizer
risks: Macroeconomic headwinds: inflation, currency depreciation, oil prices may dampen consumption growth trajectory
Brand marketing pullback if macro pressures persist; though revenue well-diversified across thousands of brands
Freight and raw material cost inflation from currency volatility; brands may pass price increases to consumers
Fashion margin sustainability dependent on maintaining assortment completeness and customer acquisition cost efficiency

analyst_pushback.pushback: Can owned brands sustain 50-65% growth with INR 1,800 crore Dot & Key base?
analyst_pushback.response: Portfolio approach; 3-4 brands at 1/3 turnover but growing 65% or 100% is very much possible

analyst_pushback.pushback: Beauty margin steady state levels; what if owned brands growth slows?
analyst_pushback.response: Core retail has highest margin profile; owned brands accretive but not sole margin driver

analyst_pushback.pushback: How reduce marketing spend yet drive more traffic and new customers?
analyst_pushback.response: AI improves funnel efficiency; personalization for new customers enables better acquisition cost efficiency

analyst_pushback.pushback: Can annual unique transacting customer growth continue at current pace 2-3 years?
analyst_pushback.response: there is headroom for growth on customer acquisition for sure

tone_evidence: Strong FY26 execution and margin expansion emphasized; but acknowledged inflation, currency, oil price macro risks make FY27 outlook uncertain despite early momentum.
